No. APPSC-12/37/2024 Dated Itanagar, the 11 th December 2025
NOTIFICATION
The date of interview/ Viva-Voce for recruitment to the post of Section Officer (SO)
and Assistant Section Officer (ASO) through Limited Departmental Competitive Examination
(LDCE)-2025 is scheduled on dates mentioned below:
SL Name of Post Date of Interview/ Viva-Voce
No.
1 Assistant Section Officer (ASO) I gth December 2025
2 Section officer (SO) 19th December 2025
The interview/ Viva-Voce shall be conducted in two sessions (morning and evening) in
APPSC new building, Itanagar.
The Call letters/ Admit card shall be mailed in the email ID provided by the Candidates
in their Application form. The same may also be collected in person on the day of interview/
viva-voce at 9:00 AM from the reception counter located in ground floor of APPSC new
building.
